id.title: Object ID
id.description: Unique ID of the object in the scene.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format at time of data acquisition.

rate.title: Sensor rate
rate.description: The rate at which the sensor is producing data.

bounding_box.title: Bounding Box
bounding_box.description: Bounding box for signaling the normalized camera coordinates of a detected object. These coordinates should be in normalized camera space.

x.description: x coordinate of the top-left corner of bounding box.

y.description: y coordinate of the top-left corner of bounding box.

width.description: Horizontal width of the bounding box.

height.description: Vertical height of the bounding box.

bounding_box_px.title: Bounding Box
bounding_box_px.description: Bounding box for signaling the normalized camera coordinates of a detected object. These coordinates should be in camera pixel space.

x.description: x coordinate of the top-left corner of bounding box.

y.description: y coordinate of the top-left corner of bounding box.

z.description: z coordinate of the top-left corner of bounding box.

width.description: Horizontal width of the bounding box.

height.description: Vertical height of the bounding box.

semantic_metadata_attribute.title: Semantic Metadata Attribute
semantic_metadata_attribute.description: A semantic attribute detected by an analytics model with label, confidence, and model source.

label.title: Label
label.description: The detected value or label for this attribute (e.g., 'Female' for gender, 'blue' for color, true/false for boolean attributes).

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence score of the detected attribute (0.0 to 1.0).

model_name.title: Model Name
model_name.description: Name or identifier of the model that generated this attribute (e.g., 'age-gender-recognition-retail-0013').

semantic_metadata.title: Semantic Metadata
semantic_metadata.description: Semantic attributes describing what an object is. Contains the extensible set of all semantic properties detected by analytics models. Each attribute follows the structure: {label, confidence, model_name}.

oneOf.description: Special case for reid embedding vectors

keypoint.title: Pose Keypoint
keypoint.description: Single pose keypoint with normalized coordinates.

name.description: Keypoint name (for example: nose, eye_l, shoulder_r).

x.description: Normalized x coordinate in image space (0 to 1).

y.description: Normalized y coordinate in image space (0 to 1).

keypoints.title: Pose Keypoints
keypoints.description: Pose keypoints when a pose estimation model is used. Coordinates are normalized to frame dimensions.

keypoint_connections.title: Keypoint Connections
keypoint_connections.description: Flat list of keypoint-name pairs defining connections (for example: ["nose", "eye_l", "nose", "eye_r"]). Length should be 2 x number_of_connections.

detection.title: Object Detection
detection.description: Metadata of an object detected in an image frame.

translation.title: Translation
translation.description: Translation of the object from coordinate space origin (x, y, z)

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Rotation of the object in quaternion

size.title: Size
size.description: Size of the object (x, y, z)

category.title: Category
category.description: Category or class of object being detected.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Inferencing confidence result for this detection.

id.title: Detection ID
id.description: Detection ID. Not expected to track the same detection from one frame to the next.

metadata.description: Semantic metadata describing what an object is (age, gender, clothing, embedding vectors, etc).

distance.title: Distance to Object
distance.description: Distance from the camera/sensor to the detection in meters, for example when using RealSense or Lidar.

mac.title: System MAC Address
mac.description: MAC address of system that acquired the data.

external_detection.title: External Source Object Observation
external_detection.description: An object observed by an external source (physical agent or child scene), expressed in the source's local coordinate frame. Unlike camera detections, size is optional: a source that cannot estimate an object's extent may report a point observation.

translation.title: Translation
translation.description: Position of the object relative to the source's local origin (x, y, z).

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Rotation of the object in quaternion (x, y, z, w).

size.title: Size
size.description: Size of the object (x, y, z). Optional; omit for a point observation with no known extent.

category.title: Category
category.description: Category or class of the observed object.

id.title: Source-Local Object ID
id.description: Identifier the source uses to correlate this observation across messages. Without global_id, track=false treats it as an exclusive identity claim.

metadata.description: Semantic metadata describing what an object is (age, gender, clothing, embedding vectors, etc).

bounding_box_px.description: Pixel-space bounding box from a camera-like external source. Mutually exclusive with translation: when this field is used, omit translation and localize from pixels using the source pose and camera intrinsics (from this message or the live pose-cache entry).

external_pose.title: External Source Pose
external_pose.description: Pose of an external source's local origin, used to transform its object observations into the target scene's coordinate frame.

reference_frame.title: Reference Frame
reference_frame.description: Frame the pose is expressed in. 'wgs84' is a global position, only resolvable when the target scene has valid geospatial calibration. 'scene' is a pose already expressed in the target scene's local coordinates and is only accepted from authorized positioning-service publishers.

lat_long_alt.title: Latitude, Longitude, Altitude
lat_long_alt.description: Global position of the source's local origin (latitude, longitude, altitude in meters). Required when reference_frame is 'wgs84'.

translation.title: Translation
translation.description: Position of the source's local origin in scene-local coordinates (x, y, z). Required when reference_frame is 'scene'.

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Orientation of the source's local origin, as a quaternion (x, y, z, w).

position_accuracy_m.title: Position Accuracy
position_accuracy_m.description: Estimated accuracy of the reported position in meters, if known.

provider.title: Pose Provider
provider.description: Informational label for what produced this pose (e.g. 'agent', 'positioning_service'). Not used for authorization.

external_camera_mount.title: External Source Fixed Camera Mount
external_camera_mount.description: Rigid transform from camera optical coordinates (x right, y down, z forward) into the source body frame. Composed with the source pose to localize pixel detections; not applied to body-relative Cartesian observations.

translation.description: Camera optical origin in source body coordinates, in meters.

rotation.description: Camera-optical-to-body quaternion (x, y, z, w). Publish a unit quaternion; the zero quaternion is invalid.

external_camera.title: External Source Camera
external_camera.description: A camera carried by an external source, with its fixed body-relative mount, calibration, and observations captured by that camera.

id.title: Camera ID
id.description: Stable camera identifier unique within the source.

objects.title: Camera Observations
objects.description: Objects observed by this camera. Cartesian translations are camera-local; bounding_box_px values are in this camera's image coordinates.

external_source.title: External Source Metadata
external_source.description: Unified contract for object observations published by external sources (physical agents such as drones or vehicles, and the Scenescape positioning service) under scenescape/external/{publisher_id}/{thing_type}, where publisher_id matches source_id. Scene membership is via consumer-side binding.

source_id.title: Source ID
source_id.description: Identifier of the publishing source; must match the topic publisher_id segment. Combined with the bound scene uid to key the source's pose cache.

pose.description: Pose of the source's local origin, for transforming 'objects' into the target scene. May be omitted to reuse the most recently cached, non-expired pose for this source_id.

intrinsics.description: Camera intrinsics for external objects localized from bounding_box_px. May be omitted to reuse the most recently cached, non-expired intrinsics for this source_id (same cache entry and TTL as pose).

distortion.description: Optional camera distortion coefficients paired with intrinsics for external pixel detections; cached with intrinsics when provided.

cameras.title: External Source Cameras
cameras.description: Cameras carried by this source. Each camera owns its calibration and observations.

objects.title: Observed Objects
objects.description: Objects observed by this source, in its local coordinate frame. May be omitted when cameras is provided, or empty when a message only updates the source's pose.

track.title: Track All Source Objects
track.description: When false, all objects bypass Scenescape tracking and use source-local id or shared global_id. When true or omitted, all objects go through normal tracking and global_id is not allowed.

source_state.title: Resolved External Source State
source_state.description: Retained scene-scoped source pose and optional camera calibration. Consumers must ignore expired states and remove a source at expires_at or on an empty MQTT payload.

singleton.title: Sensor Metadata
singleton.description: Many types of sensors exist for generating data from the physical world. This schema defines the composition of metadata for publishing sensor data into Scenescape.

detector.title: Detector Metadata
detector.description: Many types of detectors exist for generating bounding boxes around objects from image-like sources. This schema defines the composition of metadata for publishing object detection results into Scenescape.

sub_detections.title: Sub-Detections
sub_detections.description: Array of sub-detections associated with the detector output.
